tlog.msg: Deploying to a new island — new map sheets are in the library [P].
CHAPTER 3.6 — SEND IT NOW (NORMAL). Friendly strongpoint, grid 271 558 (grid bearing ~1400 mils), is under assault. Locate the attackers pressing it and destroy them without hitting the friendlies.
Par time for full stars: 3:00.
MET: wind from 5000 mils at 2 m/s — read your smoke; it will drift downwind. Rounds are not wind-corrected on this net (the FDC applies met).

Your OP: watchtower at grid 244 553, ground elev 265 m, deck +300 m. Use [B] binos and [L] laser to fix the target ([M] map, [K] mission menu), then send your call for fire — grid, polar, or shift from a known point. Hold [SPACE] to transmit by voice, or type below.

NAVIGATION: your heading readout is MAGNETIC. The grid, the map sheet and the fire net are GRID. Declination is 7° EAST, so GRID = MAG + 124 mils. Send OT DIRECTION in GRID — [R] has the conversion on the mil card, and the sheet carries the declination diagram.

Known points registered: AB1001 "BREWERY" grid 222 552 (grid brg 4745) · AB1002 "LATRINE" grid 245 570 (grid brg 0042). Shift example: "adjust fire, shift known point 1001, right 200, add 400, over" — the KP name works too ("shift BREWERY").

NO-STRIKE: civilian villages KELUFA and PARA — plotted on your map sheet. Collateral damage fails the mission, same as fratricide. Permanent structures and roads are on the sheet too — use them to orient.
>>> THE JOB: Friendly strongpoint, grid 271 558 (grid bearing ~1400 mils), is under assault. Locate the attackers pressing it and destroy them without hitting the friendlies.
SOUTHEAST OF ANVIL RK, WITHIN TWO THOUSAND METRES OF IT
This net has seen career-enders, mercy kills, and one observer who called fire on his own foxhole by accident. Let us find out which one you are, over.
Net is mid-transmission — your traffic is copied. Stand by.

immediate suppression, grid 271560, danger close, out
SHEAF: CIRCULAR (default) — nothing requested, nothing to infer — doctrine default (circular, 100 m).
FUZE: PD (default) — standard method of engagement — point detonating (quick).
MUSTANG 12, HELLHOUND FIRES — I HAVE A SPOT REPORT FOR YOU, RELAYED FROM A COASTWATCHER WHO SPEAKS THREE WORDS OF ENGLISH. SALUTE FORMAT. STAND BY, OVER.
GUNNY BOTTLECAP: This is the ONE-TRANSMISSION call, killer: "IMMEDIATE SUPPRESSION, GRID, DANGER CLOSE, OUT." No warning order, no description, no MTO. Rounds first, paperwork after.
SIZE: SQUAD PLUS — EIGHT OR MORE DISMOUNTS AND TWO LIGHT VEHICLES. ACTIVITY: ASSAULTING A FRIENDLY STRONGPOINT. LOCATION: SOUTHEAST OF ANVIL RK, WITHIN TWO THOUSAND METRES OF IT, OVER.
